snippet.title: What, the fox | Official Trailer | Play Now
snippet.description:
Welcome to a puzzle adventure like no other—where clever swipes and strategic moves guide foxes to their holes. 

Swipe to move, observe how the foxes respond, and plan your strategy. With every new chapter, brain-teasing twists like sleepy foxes and teleportation holes are added, keeping your mind engaged and the challenge fresh.

With over 100 handcrafted puzzles, an Infinite Mode, and a calm, minimalist design, every move counts. Think ahead, earn stars, and get every fox in the hole—if you can!


🔍 Play Now! https://wtfox.onelink.me/45gq
